title.en: Styling expertise mixed with shave complaints

text.en: Feedback regarding grooming finishes is divided. Long-time clients celebrate expert styling on poodles, noting beautiful top-knots and tidy coats. Conversely, a disappointed dog owner complained that groomers shaved their pet completely rather than styling the coat, finding the finished result unsatisfactory.

Reviewers acknowledge individual groomers for their talent and helpful assistance during drop-off. However, customer sentiment is mixed due to frequent employee turnover, with established patrons noting repeated changes in grooming personnel and questioning management consistency.

Communication experiences vary among patrons. While several pet parents highlight quick answers and straightforward scheduling, another client expressed frustration over a lack of advance notice regarding groomer departures, urging clearer client notification during staffing transitions.

q.en: What dog breeds are commonly groomed at Premier Pet Services?

a.en: The salon regularly grooms standard poodles, doodles, and other companion breeds requiring detailed breed trims.

q.en: How easy is it to book an appointment?

a.en: Clients report that scheduling appointments is straightforward and reception staff are generally responsive.

q.en: Can clients request a consistent individual groomer?

a.en: Reviewers note that while requesting specific stylists is common, periodic staff changes can affect groomer consistency.

q.en: Does the parlour offer complete body clipping for dogs?

a.en: Yes, groomers perform full body clips and styling cuts depending on coat condition and pet owner instructions.
